name: wemind
description: WeMind — your AI mind, reachable on WeChat. Monorepo: reusable iLink protocol core, a publishable MCP server, and a publishable always-on daemon CLI (wemind).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @wemind/wechat-ilink-core && npm run build -w @wemind/cli -w @wemind/wechat-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @wemind/wechat-ilink-core && npm run typecheck -w @wemind/cli -w @wemind/wechat-mcp
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --workspace @wemind/cli --no-git-tag-version && npm run check:version
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --workspace @wemind/cli --no-git-tag-version && npm run check:version
scripts.release:major: npm version major --workspace @wemind/cli --no-git-tag-version && npm run check:version
scripts.verify:publish: npm run check:version && npm run build && npm pack --dry-run -w @wemind/cli -w @wemind/wechat-mcp
